newsitem.title: USA: Dlr/Dow link overshawdowed by Rubin, Japan trade.
newsitem.headline: Dlr/Dow link overshawdowed by Rubin, Japan trade.

text.p: The dollar's tie to the slumping U.S. stock market is flimsy, and weakness in the U.S. unit this week is more closely tied to trade jitters in advance of U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin's arrival in Japan on Friday, currency analysts said.

Wall Street's shakeout in the wake of the Federal Reserve's first interest increase in two years last week was a handy excuse for currency traders to exit dollars as the 1997 rally increasingly showed signs of faltering.
